escalations.summary: Scoped coverage exposed core bug ef0065ad; preserve failed evidence and fix the validator in core maintenance before rerunning coverage-preview.

Planning lead found an out-of-scope cutover shim (archive legacy short-id destination fallback) and stale git background in f4d9502a. Routed the shim to b697a3f7 REQ-20 (archive destination resolution has one form) and removed from f4d9502a the bullets 842b0ac6 REQ-01/REQ-18 delete.

Profile typing vs the 3d9a0ce3 rework. Chosen (b): 2195c98f REQ-09 narrows to the domain ProfileId. The ProfilePackageId deletion and semver typing move to 3d9a0ce3 (its REQ-14/REQ-15) and build on ProfileId. Rejected (a), gating 2195c98f's profile tasks on 3d9a0ce3: it serialises all eight wave-4 epics behind an unplanned epic. Rejected (c), typing now: churn against code the rework rewrites.

notes: 2026-10-20 roster reconciliation: wave 1 is the historical July roster, all terminal (8b05a612 and 9b7b5f9c archived since). The audit program adds waves 2-5. The roster is every open epic labelled milestone:v1.0 that the v1.0 tag task bb03df0a reaches (D-14). They are not direct milestone children.

Wave 2 runs concurrently on main without worktrees, because the user recruited peer sessions that share the checkout: just-in-time-05 executes 8376299c (filed with worker-sized children; no bracket; the user directed execution directly), just-in-time-7e plans 842b0ac6, and steward subagents plan 3d9a0ce3 and df129d9e. Leads commit only their own files.

Wave 3: just-in-time-59 started planning 2195c98f early. Its planning node depends on 842b0ac6 through the plan template's upstream move, so it cannot pass its gates until the cutover is done. Investigation can proceed.
Wave 4 planning nodes depend on 2195c98f the same way. Wave 5 is the release epic b80e3c70 containing the tag task bb03df0a.

Session rule from the user (2026-10-20): never ask the user mid-session; block issues needing user input and record the question for the next session; check workers every 30 min; write the handoff when only user-blocked work remains.
Cutover integration note from 7e: 19 gitignored .jit/issues/*.lock files cannot be removed by a commit; the executing lead deletes them in the primary checkout at integration.
Tooling note: `jit claim acquire` sets the assignee and `claim release` does not restore it. Unassign after steward lease edits, and never lease an issue assigned to someone else.
